verdict.rationale: Svelte compiles components into JavaScript that 'surgically updates the DOM' directly, and effects run after real DOM updates. A hands-on user also reports stepping through readable compiled component code while profiling a layout-per-frame issue, which corroborates debugging in the browser. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of devtools debugging or element inspection, and any mention of a dedicated devtools extension or source-map workflow.
